collated-composite-pk.finding: LEAK W1/W3: collated (case-insensitive) tenant in the PK. The oracle's postgres guard `t.tenant = excluded.tenant COLLATE "C"` is evaluated under the column collation on CockroachDB and lets tenant 'ACME' overwrite tenant 'acme' (on PostgreSQL the explicit COLLATE wins). The ::text-cast guard no-ops (E, no leak); unguarded form overwrites. Schema gate must refuse collated tenant/key columns and the CockroachDB guard must cast both sides to text
